nom: Drunk Elephant E-Rase Milki Micellar Water

avis.texte: I use this product to remove my eye make-up. Removes all traces of mascara, eye liner, eye shadow, and concealer with no irritation whatsoever to my ultra-sensitive eyes. No other product like it!

It is extremely pricey but this is the only way to remove my layers of mascara without any irritation and without losing any lashes, better than any micellar water or any makeup remover ive ever used. Had to repurchase it
I use this product as a first step in my skin care routine after washing and drying. It is fabulous. No residue absorbs nicely
This product is smooth and easy to use. It cleans well and does not burn eyes.
Perfect for my delicate eye area. I just press a cotton pad saturated with E-rase on my eye lid for a few seconds. . It quickly dissolves my eye make up. And it dies not irritate my skin n

avis.titre: I will buy and have bought this product repeatedly
avis.texte: This way of cleansing my face works so much better than any harsher, foaming, soap-like products. It leaves the skin softer yet clearly removes makeup and any unwanted daily residual toxins accumulated on the skin.
This is an excellent product with its ingredients but it is just to spendy for me for a micellar cleanser. I will likely use a cheaper version or wash my face
I use this after my workout for a quick cleanse. Works well and is not sticky.
Clean , refreshing and easy to use. I like the way it makes my skin feel. Soft and refreshed

Because of this micellar water, I actually have started washing my face at night for the first time in my life. It is so easy to use and it doesn't irritate my rosacea. A bottle lasts a long time, too.

The 1st one that I actually see dirt on the pad after wiping. And it is completely non-drying. The playdo scent has disappeared now that I'm halfway through bottle. Or maybe I got used to it. As long as it's not perfume, I'm good. I had given up on mic. waters cleansing my skin until now.

avis.titre: I use this multiple times a day as a skin refresher
avis.texte: Not only do I use it, but I've gotten my 14 year-old son to use it as well. He is Ethiopian and has combination skin. It works great and he loves how it cleans and hydrates after sports.

avis.titre: Love how this settles into skin
avis.texte: I was gifted by drunk elephant their Milki Micellar water and I must say it is so refreshing on the face, I've been using it after I cleanse and wash my face because they say you don't need to rub it off you can just let it saturate into the skin and they are totally right. It doesn't feel too slimey or heavy when sitting on your face at all. The consistency of this water is so gentle and calming on my face

I love how gently this micellar water removes makeup and dirt, leaving my skin feeling clean and refreshed without any rinsing required. This is seriously the perfect way to freshen up my skin throughout the day, especially when I'm going makeup-free. It's super easy to use - just a quick shake and then smooth it over my face with a cotton pad. Plus, the milky texture feels so nourishing on my skin, and gives me an extra boost of hydration. I'm totally obsessed with how soft and cool my skin feels after using it. I received this product complimentary from Drunk Elephant in exchange for my honest review.

I really love their cleanser, and this one is just as good! It has a beautiful texture that gently removes makeup without irritating my eyes. It says no rinse, but I prefer to wash it off anyway simply because I feel like acne-prone skin is safer that way. Love it! Gifted by Drunk Elephant.

Super gentle but efficient in removing makeup and debris from my face. Doesn't break me out and leaves my skin feeling soft and moisturized. It doesn't have a scent which I appreciate. The packaging is also nice. Gifted by drunkelephant

This is by far, the most gentle micellar water that I have ever used! It's milky, has nourishing oils inside, so it really breaks down everything that you're wearing sort of like an oil cleanser would but even more gentle than oil cleansing - if that's even possible. It leaves my skin so fresh and hydrated. I couldn't be more obsessed! Gifted by drunk elephant for my honest review

This did a really good job cleaning off my makeup. I wouldn't say it's extraordinarily different than any other misceller water but it did leave my skin feeling very clean and not dry. This was gifted to me by drunk elephant

I love this micellar water from drunk elephant! I have sensitive skin so it's always scary for me to try products like this but it works perfectly and really helps soothe my skin as take off The makeup you thought you got off. Offered by drunk elephant

I love this micellar water from drunk elephant! I have sensitive skin so it's always scary for me to try products like this but it works perfectly and really helps soothe my skin as take off The makeup you thought you got off. Offered by drunk elephant

I received the E-Rase Milki Micellar Water gifted by Drunk Elephant and I am absolutely in love with it. I was surprised at how smooth it left my face feeling and it made my face feel clean. This product does not make my face feel dry or stripped whatsoever. Highly recommend.

This micellar water is my new favorite! It removed my makeup gently and didn't sting my eyes at all, which always happens to me with removers. I love how it makes me skin feel clean and soft afterwards. I also love how I don't have to rinse again. Gifted by Drunkelephant.

Absolutely love this makeup remover!! Of course it's going to be amazing just as expected gifted by drunk elephant ! It doesn't dry out your face at all and doesn't leave that tight dry feeling after! I love how it removes absolutely everything even that hard to remove waterproof mascara! Definitely recommend it leaves your face feeling hydrated and clean at the same time!!

The best powder puff. I love how the price point is and it works really well. Better than most puffs. I definitely recommend it and use it for setting my face with powder. I love how smooth it applies

A nice micellar water to help get rid of your stubborn mascara and eye liner. It does a great job at cleansing the face. I have sensitive skin and sometimes micellar water can irritate my face but this one doesn't seem to. Gifted by drunk elephant for my honest review

avis.titre: Gentle and feels nice, could clean a little better
avis.texte: This is a nice concept and definitely feels gentle and smooth on the skin. It doesn't leave my skin feeling stripped, but I do have to say that it didn't feel like I was getting as deep of a clean as when I use my usual micellar water (I use both with the same cotton pads). It didn't irritate my eyes or make my contacts blurry, but I felt like I either needed to use more product or spend extra time to totally remove my relatively light eye makeup. Maybe it's just a learning curve as to how much to use or it would work better with a denser, less fluffy cotton pad. Gifted by Drunk Elephant

The E-rase Micellar Water by Drunk Elephant is a gentle yet effective makeup remover and cleanser. It efficiently lifts away impurities and makeup without stripping the skin of its natural oils. It's suitable for all skin types, including sensitive skin, and leaves the skin feeling refreshed and hydrated. Overall, it's a solid choice for anyone looking for a fuss-free cleansing solution. Offered by drunkelephant

This product was gifted by drunkelephant and love it because it does not have a strong fragrance at all! This misceller waters I've tried in the past always had a strong fragrance. The product comes out as a whitish, clear color and removes my make up quickly and easily!

This micellar water doubles as an excellent makeup remover. I've struggled with removing stubborn mascaras in the past, but this product effortlessly tackles the task. It's a win-win situation for me, and I'll certainly be buying it again!Gifted by Drunk Elephant.

I love how this makes me feel like I just got out the shower with a clean face! I am usually a bit skeptical with products but this was and is AMAZING stuff! The packaging is so nice too and I can already tell that this will be a top tier make up remover offered by drunkelephant

This micellar water really gets ALL your makeup off for sureeeerrr I always struggle taking mascara off and this definitely helps me get it all off with just one swipe! It's amazing !!!! Gifted by drunkelephant

Gifted by Drunk Elephant I'm jumping for joy over Drunk Elephant's E-Rase Milki Micellar Water. A cleanser that is so gentle, nourishing and balancing with none of the bad stuff. The milki formula glides on smooth and wipes on effortlessly. No rince necessary if you need a quick refresh.

I haven't purchased the micellar water in like 10 years. I received this Milky micellar water and have been using it for couple weeks now, it is so gentle to the skin but at the same time really helps clean the make up off! The skin feels soft, hydrated and clean afterwards! Not sticky, not dry Gifted by drunkelephant

Gifted by Drunkelephant. This is by far the best way to remove makeup! It gently removes dirt and makeup leaving my skin super clean! I also love how I don't have to wash it off, I can just put it on a cotton pad, swipe my makeup off and go to bed! It also feels super hydrating which is nice as well! I would recommend this product to anyone who wears makeup and is looking for an easier way to take it off.

I was gifted by Drunk Elephant this E-rase milki Micellar water. This Micellar water helps remove makeup, oils and pollution from my skin and leaves it super clean and hydrated. Thus is great for all skin types too

It's a great micellar water + make up remover. I have a few mascaras that are super hard to remove but this micellar water does it without a problem. So it's a win win for me and I will definitely repurchase it! Gifted by Drunk Elephant

One of the best micellar waters out there. 1. Affordable 2. Removes all makeup like charm 3. The quantity you use is so little to remove a lot 4. does not give me pimples since i have sensitive skin. 5. is not sticky or slick feeling gifted by drunkelephant

This micellar water works great for removing makeup and mascara especially on the days I dont want to do my full routine before bed. I have sensitive eyes and this doesn't sting or cause irritation. The bottle is a bit smaller than other micellar waters but I only use it when I am really lazy. Offered by drunk elephant

avis.titre: I bring it wth me everywhere
avis.texte: This stuff is great. I didnt normally use micellar water very often before finding this, but this one has gotten some use out of it. It works super well for removing makeup, even waterproof mascara, without having to rub or pull on my skin at all. I use this most often after working out so I can freshen up my face quickly. My skin feels healthy, refreshed and clean without that weird almost greasy feeling I've experienced with other brands. gifted by drunk elephant.

I absolutely love Drunk Elephant Rich Micellar Water! It cleanses my skin gently, removing makeup and impurities while keeping it hydrated and refreshed. A staple in my skincare routine! Would recommend gifted by drunkelephant

The E-Rase Milki Micellar Water is thicker than your typical micellar water. It feels hydrating and removes makeup very easily without any irritation. It removed mascara and eyeliner with ease. It can also be used to refresh the skin, it contains a 3 ceramide blend & wild watermelon seed oil to help hydrate. It feels soothing to my skin and helps to support a healthy skin barrier. Gifted by Drunkelephant

I received complimentary from Drunk Elephant. A brilliant ID combining micellar water with an ultra moisture milky blend rich antioxidant rich plant oils for the removal of makeup on my sensitive skin. E-Rase™ nourishes skin while dissolving away makeup, sunscreen and dirt without any need to rinse.

I used it for the first time to remove makeup and it took forever to remove all my makeup. I went throught a lot of cotton pads get my makeup off. I keep using more and more product, hoping that my makeup would finally be removed, but no. I had to use a different makeup remover product to remove my makeup. The next morning, I woke up with small break outs on my face. For the price of this product, it is not worth it. There are cheaper miceller water products.

This is a great micellar water! It removed my makeup really well, and it left my face feeling refreshed and clean! It's very gentle and a great product for me since I have sensitive skin! I love how it doesn't have any fragrance too. Gifted by drunk elephant!

avis.titre: I would buy this a million times
avis.texte: I am in love with this product it is amazing it works great for my skin I am in love with this product is is great my skin cleared up quickly and it has taken. Care of a lot of things for me this is so great gifted by drunk elephant

What I love most about this micellar water is how it leaves my skin feeling clean, refreshed, and hydrated. Unlike some makeup removers that can leave behind a greasy residue or tight, dry feeling, this one leaves my skin balanced and comfortable. gifted by drunkelephant

The texture is so nice! It does feel like this miky texture instead of the watery texture that you normally see for micellar water. It doesn't have a strong fragrance smell which makes it feel more natural and it removes my makeup pretty well as expected! Offered by drunkelephant

This cleanser is very milky, the color is white and the texture is a little thicker than micellar waters. It does a good job cleaning off my makeup. It didn't irritate around my eyes like some cleansers, and didn't left my skin feel dry. Gifted by Drunk Elephant.

This Micellar Water is the best way to take off my makeup! It removes any dirt, makeup, and grime and doesn't leave residue. I love how clean and glowy it leaves my skin and makes it so hydrated! My new favorite offered by drunk elephant

really pretty packaging I love drunk elephant erased my make up really cleanly and fast I didn't really have to rub on my eye make up as much as I usually do amazing and I'll definitely rebuy again!!! offered by drunkelephant

love all drunk elephant packaging, everything looks so cute and high end, this one too. i want to like this but a lot of drunk elephant stuff is not good for my super sensitive skin. will keep using to see if its okay. gifted by drunk elephant

avis.titre: Great for removing makeup with ease
avis.texte: Gifted by Drunk Elephant in exchange for my honest review. I haven't tried micellar water in a while, but I was intrigued when DE released a version and knew it had to be good! This definitely makes it easy to remove makeup and leaves my skin feeling extremely clean. I used this as the first step in my double cleanse routine and honestly I feel like only using this would work for me. My makeup literally melts off and my skin doesn't feel stripped after using it.

Drunk Elephant's E-rase Milki Micellar Water has drastically improved the cleanliness of my skin. The milky and hydrating texture dissolves makeup and impurities, in addition to cleansing the skin. The three ceramides and melon seed oil aid in purifying without stripping the skin. I love how quickly the micellar water cleanses and makes my skin feel! Gifted by drunk elephant

I got gifted by drunkelephant, the Drunk Elephant E-Rase Milki Micellar Water and I must say, I'm impressed! The gentle formula effectively removed all my makeup without drying out my skin. The packaging is sleek and convenient, making it easy to use. I love that it doesn't irritate my sensitive skin. This micellar water has definitely become a staple in my skincare routine!

I received this micellar water complimentary from drunk elephant. This micellar water makes my skin feel so refreshed and fully removes all my makeup without the need to double cleanse! I like using this in the morning as a refresher for my skin also. It is so gentle on the skin and leaves my face feeling hydrated and clean.

Gifted by Drunk Elephant! This is definitely my new favorite product! Cheaper than most Drunk Elephant products, and is such a nice consistency. This removes my makeup so nicely. Also, you get so much product!

I love drunk elephant Micellar water to remove my makeup. This is the first Micellar water which doesn't strip my skin but rather leaves it hydrated , clean , makeup free and smooth. Gifted by drunk elephant

Gently removes my make up while infusing my skin with all the good ingredients like ceramides. No need to rub or tug and it's so gentle yet effective and removes all my dirt and impurities on my skin. It's the best micellar water I've ever used and I have tried a lot! It's packaged in the cutest bottle.gifted by drunkelephant

Micellar water is great for sensitive skin. The molecules in the surfactants form micelles, which adhere to your cotton round or pad and attract dirt and oil as you sweep it across your face. This formula created a more luxurious experience. It left my skin feeling soothed and soft. No burn whatsoever. Gifted by Drunkelephant.

avis.titre: Deserves more hype than it gets
avis.texte: It's an atrocity that my dear Milki Micellar Water has so few reviews. As someone who's never written a review, I couldn't let my absolute favorite product down. I buy this stuff two at a time, so I always have a stock at home. It truly cleanses the skin of dirt while simultaneously hydrating the skin. It's soothing on irritated and inflamed skin, as well as one of the most gentle cleansers you can find if you struggle with skin picking. If you're on the fence, just try it, you won't be disappointed.

avis.titre: My Holy Grail - please do not discontinue!
avis.texte: I have noticed the E-Rase being out of stock everywhere recently and I'm super disappointed because it is truly the best product ever. It is like a magic formula. Super milky and refreshing. Removes makeup easily and doubles as a soothing toner/essence that preps your skin for the day. Please bring this product back!

This is the best product I've ever put on my face in my entire life. The glow. The smoothness. My face is clear. (I mix it with my Cetaphil moisturizer and something also my vitamin C serum. Those products aside, this is the driving force to why my face looks so good. I saw an immediate change.)
Perfect way to remove stubborn eye make up before heading off to bed

avis.titre: Great way to end the day!
avis.texte: I'm not the best at removing my makeup at the end of the day especially since I'm a minimalist with makeup. This product makes developing a night routine easy. Makes my skin feel clean without being stripped and ready for serum and moisturizer.

I was looking for a gentle Micellar Water and decided to try this one. It works quickly, non irritating and a little bit goes a long way. There is no residue left behind and that is something which is huge.
Great price for a great product! Removes makeup and dirt and leaves your skin feelinv soft.
on my first order, i got the deluxe sample size and im so glad they had that at the time because when i tried it, it was so good like im in LOVEEE. i need a restock 🤞🏻

This product is soooooo good removes my makeup easily abd does not leave my fave feeling sticky like other micellar water's I have used in the past! Pro tip: put product on your hands then rub on you face to remove makeup, after doing this get a wet towel and remove residue. This works so much better than putting product on cotton pad than rubbing on face! 🫶🏻🫶🏻
This micellar is good for a makeup free or sunscreen only kind of day. Otherwise, it takes a lot of the product to remove makeup so it doesn't last long.

This is by far the best Drunk Elephant product I have ever purchased. It takes off makeup, hydrates the skin, and when you wake up your face is INSANELY smooth. I will repurchase again and again. I am very happy with this, and it's not super expensive.

avis.titre: Absolutely love! NOT A MAKEUP REMOVER!
avis.texte: This is to be used more as a hudrating toner after wagsing your face! Its super silky and leaves your skin feeling so soft! It is expensive but i love it

This product is INCREDIBLE- when used properly. This is not just a makeup remover that you "rub" on your face!! Drench your delivery tool- I highly recommend getting cotton pads instead of cotton balls, or my person favorite, the makeup eraser toner puffs! I feel like those puffs don't remove on their own but they're so soft and reusable!- then lightly press and hold for 30 seconds on makeuped areas and gently massage. I also use this like a toner/essence because it feels so cooling and refreshing plus it's PH balanced perfectly. My only ask is that they make a bigger size soon, because I will literally buy this for the rest of my life! 🥲🧡
have used only 2 times but it took off all my makeup really fast and left my face soft! the only problem is that it smells gross like play dough but other than that great product!

avis.titre: Dont use cotton pads, use something reusable!
avis.texte: No joke, at first i really disliked this product. I was using it with the Shisedo cotton pads (another HG product of mine) and i felt like i just could not get enough makeup off for the amount of product i was using. But then… I tried it with a mini Makeup Eraser. Game. Changed. Y'all! Makeup has never come off easier and my skin has never felt cleaner after using micellar water. I still double cleanse as i am acne prone if i wear makeup, but this first step combo has alleviated a lot of my skincare anxiety around that problem. The film i felt when i used the cotton is also gone. It is pricey, no doubt, so if that is what keeps you from your purchase i totally get it. But just know… if it didnt work when you used cotton? Try it with a microfiber cloth. You might change your mind!!
I was extremely disappointed in this product. This was the worst micellar water I have ever tried. Doesn't clean skin, and is thick. Waste of money.
I like how this cleanser makes my skin feel so soft. It's just very expensive. I can't speak to the makeup removing abilities because I don't wear foundation.

I'll start with the good. This product feels good when applied to my face. It's not drying, and the fragrance is not overpowering (although it is a little funky smelling for). The scent reminds me of rice ferment, which I actually don't dislike. This product is definitely not bad. I cannot justify the price though. I use it after working out before I shower, so I cannot speak to its makeup removal properties bc all it removes is my sunscreen and sweat before I shower. It's definitely meant to be a leave-on treatment bc the runoff stings my eyes in the shower if I don't cleanse right away. i cannot recommend bc I could arguably get the same results from a lower priced micellar water (and have, from Vichy's micellar for sensitive skin). As someone that is willing to invest into higher end products (I am a big fan of Dr Jart, Fresh, Dear Klairs, Josie Maran, Typology, and Sunday Riley leave-on products and use Dermalogica pre-cleanse and daily microfoliant) but especially since I wash this off almost immediately after use when it is meant to be left on it's just not a good fit for me. a Arguably, I could save money by using my Dermalogica cleansing oil in the morning, too, but I prefer the no-fuss of using micellar in the morning, especially since I'm only removing residue from my night routine, sunscreen, and sweat.

After my eye makeup remover began irritating my skin quite a bit, I switched to Micellar water, but didn't like the oily feel it gave my eyelids. This stuff has been a great solution for me. I don't think it removes quite as well as something like my Estée Lauder blue bottle took off my mascara, but it doesn't hurt my eyes like that stuff does now. I use a washcloth and press it gently to my eye to allow it to soak off my makeup and am pretty happy with the results. Since I used this for my eyes only the bottle lasts a long time and the price is reasonable for me, but it probably would go quite fast if you use it for your whole face. I'd recommend it particularly for people with sensitive skin like me. I use the Tula milky cleaner for washing the rest of my face.
This micellar water keeps my skin clear, clean, refreshed. I use it morning and night. When I start to run low I immediately buy a backup so I'm never out.

This works amazingly, bit of an odd smell, but it gets lash adhesive off so it's amazing. But it's too expensive for the amount and I can't justify buying it again, not when there's products out there that'll do the same or close enough for a much better price.

avis.titre: Not good for removing eye makeup
avis.texte: I tried so hard to love this product, but it did not remove my eye makeup as well as I had hoped. It also burned my eyes horribly, even when using a cotton round. I also went through at least 3 cotton rounds every time I used it and my makeup was still not completely removed. I will be returning this product and sticking with Tula.

everyone using a cotton round stop and wash your hands and use them instead, it's also better for your face. this micellar water is perfect for double cleansing with this being the first "remover cleanse" and follow up with your everyday cleanser and yall won't be left with a greasy feeling

I just want to say that I usually use the neutrogena micelar water and love it, but I bought this because I wanted to treat myself to something a little fancier. I was a bit worried about the price, but the Drunk elephant micellar water lasted me almost FIVE MONTHS. I wear makeup pretty often and would go through a bottle of neutrogena in less than a month probably. I love this makeup remover!! I found it works be at when you just pour some in your hands and massage your makeup off. Cotton pads and things like that absorb too much of the product. I like to use a cotton pad to remove the product and then wash my face with soap after. Definitely would recommend!!!

I don't understand the less then 5 start reviews. This stuff is amazing. I can cleanse my face and then use this afterwards and the amount of stuff it still finds on my skin is mind blowing. I can't be without it. Also love the scent. I guess to each their own. For me it's a strong must must must have.

Finally! A micellar water I can use! Thank you Drunk Elephant! The first one that hasn't given me a terrible rash. It's so lovely. It goes on easily, doesn't bother my eyes, comes right off and my skin is ready for the next step. Not sticky or oily just clean, soft and smooth and ready for my serums and moisturizers.

avis.titre: not for me, I have combination skin
avis.texte: my skin was under control for a long time and I decided to try this and the last couple weeks I keep getting pimples and my skin feels gross when i use it... its a nice smooth texture. but you have to use a lot to get it working. it's not the worst and has good ingredients, but doesn't help me sadly. I have to go back to to regular micellar water that's more clear

I was extremely disappointed in this product. I'm an avid makeup wearer and liberal double-cleanser. I tried this out as my first step in my nightly regimen and found myself going through so much cotton to get my makeup off compared to other brands (La Roche Posay and IT Cosmetics). The texture was goopy and extremely heavy even for a dry skin person like myself. It left an uncomfortable texture behind so I wouldn't recommend this for people who want a no-rinse cleanser either. Also was not a fan of the scent. Smells like stale Play-Doh.
My skin is no where near sensitive and this gave me a bruising look around my eyes and mouth. Really hope they reformulate soon.

Decent cleanser, does the job. Smells like playdoh though and it takes a lot to cleanse my whole face… not sure if it's the cotton pad I'm using but it's absorbed so quickly. Really the only plus is that it's not stripping and leaves my skin soft. Glad I got the mini as I will not be repurchasing.

avis.titre: great product, not so great smell
avis.texte: I do really like this micellar water, it literally melts off my makeup. I would give it 5 stars but it literally smells like playdoh.
the milky texture is really nice and soothing to me. I love that it actually does cleanse. but is smells like play-doh...like really strongly.
Was last minute to fill in for Clarins one step cleanser I use at night. Clarins order was delayed. LOVE the Clarins product-not the Drunken Elephant.
Removes eye makeup very easily! My new favorite. No worries about having removed cleansing balm or blurriness.

avis.titre: I love how it makes my face feel!
avis.texte: I tried this for the first time this morning. My face felt so clean and soft afterward! There was no feeling of residue...just softness. My face has been feeling dry and this made a great difference. My dull skin also looks much brighter.

Love this product to help with the stubborn eye makeup the Slaai doesn't totally get off. Also a wonderful refresher for morning and night to wash off the day. Skin feels soft and noticably clearer. Smells great too!
Even removes stubborn waterproof makeup! Without any kind of gross oily residue! Drunk Elephant is by far the best skincare brand on the market! I am a forever customer!! ♥️
